import json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import expm
import covariant_root_transfer as root
import covariant_induced_photon as photon
cfg=root.Parameters(kappa_power=400,beta_power=150,spatial_size=2**24,time_slices=2**20)
gamma,_=photon.phi_frame(cfg)
p=root.RootParameters(normal_width_power=2000,tube_radius_power=2100)
pin=np.array(p.momentum);q=np.array([1e-10,0.,0.]);pol=np.array([0.,1.,0.])
provider=photon.soft_photon_transfer_vertex(gamma,p.a,p.mass,pin,q,pol,emission=False)
frame=provider['initial_canonical_frame'];consumer=photon.WilsonConsumer(gamma,p.a,p.mass)
values=np.repeat([np.exp(-consumer.energy(pin)),np.exp(consumer.energy(pin))],2)
physical_provider=frame@np.diag(values)@frame.conj().T
physical_root,detB,energy=root.wilson_step(gamma,p.a,p.mass,pin)
vals,modes=np.linalg.eigh(physical_root)
particle=modes[:,vals<1]@modes[:,vals<1].conj().T
sea=modes[:,vals>1]@modes[:,vals>1].conj().T
h=1e-5
current=(root.wilson_step(gamma,p.a,p.mass,pin+h*pol)[0]-root.wilson_step(gamma,p.a,p.mass,pin-h*pol)[0])/(2*h)
theta=root.wilson_component_basis(gamma)
provider_current=theta@provider['native_field_derivative']@theta.conj().T
in_modes=modes.conj().T@current@modes
log_current=modes@(np.array([[-photon.log_first(float(x),float(y)) for y in vals] for x in vals])*in_modes)@modes.conj().T
provider_h=provider['final_canonical_frame']@provider['vertex_without_oscillator']@frame.conj().T
v=expm(.17j*(root.matrix_unit_basis()[0]+.27*root.matrix_unit_basis()[3]))
